channel.title: Claude Code Live Cheatsheet
channel.description: Auto-updating cheatsheet for Claude Code — keyboard shortcuts, commands, tips, and more.

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.167 highlights
item.description:
• fallbackModel setting: up to 3 fallback models tried in order (v2.1.166)
  • Glob patterns in deny rules (* denies all tools) (v2.1.166)
  • --thinking disabled disables thinking on default-thinking models (v2.1.166)
  • --fallback-model now also applies to interactive sessions (v2.1.166)
  • SendMessage relayed messages no longer carry user authority (v2.1.166)
  • Bug fixes and reliability improvements (v2.1.167)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.166
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] fallbackModel: Up to 3 fallback models tried in order when primary is overloaded
+ [config-env] deny: tool-name glob: * denies all tools; allow rules reject non-MCP globs
+ [cli-flags] --thinking: disabled turns off thinking on models that think by default
~ [cli-flags] --fallback-model: Fallback when primary unavailable (interactive + headless)
~ [config-env] MAX_THINKING_TOKENS: 0=off; disables thinking on models that think by default
- [config-env] pluginSuggestionMarketplaces
- [config-env] allowAllClaudeAiMcps

Full changelog

• Added `fallbackModel` setting to configure up to three fallback models tried in order when the primary model is overloaded or unavailable; `--fallback-model` now also applies to interactive sessions
• Added glob pattern support in deny rule tool-name position (`"*"` denies all tools); allow rules reject non-MCP globs, and unknown tool names in deny rules warn at startup
• Hardened cross-session messaging: messages relayed via `SendMessage` from other Claude sessions no longer carry user authority — receivers refuse relayed permission requests, and auto mode blocks them
• `MAX_THINKING_TOKENS=0`, `--thinking disabled`, and the per-model thinking toggle now disable thinking on models that think by default via the Claude API (3P providers unchanged)
• Claude Code now retries a turn once on the fallback model when the API rejects an unexpected non-retryable error; auth, rate-limit, request-size, and transport errors still surface immediately
• `claude update` now announces the target version before downloading instead of going silent
• `claude agents`: typing a URL into the list now filters to the session whose first prompt contained it
• Fixed a recurring "image could not be processed" error and extra token usage when an unprocessable image was sent in a session
• Fixed remote sessions becoming permanently stuck when a brief backend disruption occurred during worker registration at startup
• Fixed flickering in JetBrains IDE terminals (IntelliJ, PyCharm, WebStorm, etc.) on 2026.1+ by enabling synchronized output
• Fixed Shift+non-ASCII characters (e.g. Shift+ä → Ä) being dropped in terminals using the Kitty keyboard protocol (WezTerm, Ghostty, kitty)
• Fixed PowerShell command validation occasionally hanging far past its time budget on Windows when a killed process's children held its output pipes
• Fixed orphaned `claude --bg-pty-host` processes spinning at 100% CPU after the daemon dies while connected on macOS
• Fixed voice mode requiring `/login` to clear a stale auth check after toggling `/voice`
• Fixed managed settings with an invalid entry silently disabling enforcement of their remaining valid policies
• Fixed managed-settings `allowedMcpServers`/`deniedMcpServers` predicates not matching when they use `${VAR}` references
• Fixed background agent sessions that entered a git worktree crash-looping with "No conversation found" when reopened from `claude agents`
• Fixed duplicated thinking text in the Ctrl+O transcript view while streaming
• Fixed `/doctor` showing a contradictory failed "Not inside a remote session" check when run inside a remote session
• Fixed the cursor sticking at the end of the first line when typing a multiline prompt in the `claude agents` dispatch and reply inputs
• Fixed blank lines appearing between background agent rows in the task list on terminals without Unicode support

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.163
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [slash-commands] /plugin list [--enabled|--disabled]: List installed plugins with status filters
+ [config-env] requiredMinimumVersion / requiredMaximumVersion: Managed settings; refuses start if version outside allowed range

~ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID: Session ID passed to stdio MCP server subprocesses (also on --resume)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.154
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [keyboard-shortcuts] ←←: Open agents view
+ [slash-commands] /workflows: View dynamic workflow runs
+ [slash-commands] /chrome: Select connected browser for Chrome integration
+ [slash-commands] /logout: Sign out (in agents view)
+ [cli-flags] claude --bg --exec '<cmd>': Run shell command as attachable background session
+ [config-env] defaultEnabled: Plugin default disabled in plugin.json; enable with /plugin
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID: Session ID passed to stdio MCP server subprocesses
+ [skills-agents] /simplify: Cleanup-only review (reuse, simplify, efficiency, altitude) and apply fixes
+ [workflows-tips] Dynamic workflows: Ask Claude to create; orchestrates tens to hundreds of agents
~ [slash-commands] /effort [level]: Set effort; interactive slider (low–max; Faster/Smarter labels)
~ [skills-agents] Workflow: Dynamic multi-agent orchestration (opt-in); /workflows to view runs
~ [workflows-tips] 1M context: Opus 4.8 (Max/Team/Ent)
~ [workflows-tips] /effort: ○ low · ◐ med · ◑ xhigh · ● high/max (Faster↔Smarter)
~ [mcp-servers] claude mcp list: List all servers (⏸ = pending approval)
- [keyboard-shortcuts] Ctrl+U
- [slash-commands] /scroll-speed
- [slash-commands] /color [color]
- [slash-commands] /tui [fullscreen]
- [cli-flags] --channels
- [config-env] worktree.baseRef
- [config-env] OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_ENTRYPOINT

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.139
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [slash-commands] /goal [condition]: Set completion condition; Claude works across turns until met
+ [slash-commands] /scroll-speed: Tune mouse wheel scroll speed with live preview
+ [keyboard-shortcuts] { / }: Jump between user prompts (transcript view)
+ [keyboard-shortcuts] ?: Show keyboard shortcuts (transcript view)
+ [cli-flags] claude agents: Agent view — list every CC session (running/blocked/done)
+ [cli-flags] claude plugin details <name>: Show plugin component inventory and projected token cost
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR: Project dir passed to MCP stdio servers and hooks env
+ [config-env] args: string[]: Hook exec form — spawn directly without shell
+ [config-env] continueOnBlock: PostToolUse: feed rejection reason back to Claude, continue turn
+ [mcp-servers] ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}: Reference project dir in MCP server commands
+ [workflows-tips] API key → no cloud: API key disables Remote Control, /schedule, claude.ai MCP, notifications
- [keyboard-shortcuts] Ctrl V
- [keyboard-shortcuts] P
- [slash-commands] /cost
- [slash-commands] /team-onboarding
- [config-env] wslInheritsWindowsSettings
- [config-env] CwdChanged
- [config-env] FileChanged
